messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Passing calculated data to outputs
parts:
In the tabset example in the tutorial a numeric vector is calculated and passed to a reactivePlot (histogram) and reactivePrint (summary)

if I am calculating a more complex example with say two dataframes each with 2 columns e.g df1$a,df1$b, df2$y,df2$z how would I make them available
for use and actually reference them in reactive functions

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Passing calculated data to outputs
parts:
Just do it in exactly the same way, put each expression in a reactive(function() {...}) and refer to it later as if it is a function call.

If the two columns of each dataframe are expensive to recalculate and are based on (semi-)independent sets of input variables, you may want to break each of those columns into a separate reactive function as well, so you don't do more recalculating than is necessary.

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Passing calculated data to outputs
parts:
The last statement in the function should be df, not df$count. Then from your other reactive functions/plots/etc. you can call data()$count if you want the count, data()$name if you want the name, etc. Basically, df and data() would be exactly equivalent.

Does that clear things up?
